description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Walakumburumalla, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420521 (24/0227).
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including specific land parcel determinations, ownership details, property descriptions, and encumbrances. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, property extents, and legal status - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
